name: bchsonify-vendor
description: Builds web/vendor/wizardconnect.js (WizardConnect dapp side, libauth, QR codes) with esbuild: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run build

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --legal-comments=eof --banner:js="/* BCHSonify vendor bundle, built from tools/vendor (npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run build). Contains @wizardconnect/core and @wizardconnect/dapp (LGPL-3.0-or-later, Whiterun LLC; source: https://gitlab.com/riftenlabs/lib/wizardconnect), @bitauth/libauth (MIT), nostr-tools (Unlicense), @noble/* and @scure/* (MIT), eventemitter3 (MIT), lossless-json (MIT), qrcode-generator (MIT). Rebuild it from that folder to swap any of them. */" --outfile=../../web/vendor/wizardconnect.js
